text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As a token of victory, Meisho Doto 
receives a beam of good fortune from 
Matikanefukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Carrying this light forward, she heads for 
the Takarazuka Kinen. It would test 
whether she could truly become a knight 
worthy of protecting T.M. Opera O.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Air Shakur tells her Trainer 
that Meisho Doto's stats have finally 
filled her vessel to the brim.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The real problem, however, lay ahead. 
Meisho Doto, T.M. Opera O, and Air Shakur 
all had to challenge the wall of their own 
limits.
